Kerala Governor Approves Seshadrinathan's State Election Commissioner Appointment Amidst Controversy

Kerala Governor has given assent to the appointment of Seshadrinathan as the State Election Commissioner. The nomination faced criticism from within the ruling Congress and the CPI(M), who alleged the appointee had ties to the RSS. Dissent has also surfaced within the Congress over the Kerala Chief Minister's alleged lack of consultation regarding the appointment.
